text_block_list.name: Wil & Vib
text_block_list.text:
Cheval, happy birthday! Happy birthday, 
Cheval-chi~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you... for celebrating. I'm 
sorry, doing all this for someone like 
me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I have to go get ready for 
fishing, so...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment. We're coming fishing with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chi, teach me some sea fishing 
tips!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna catch a huge fish for 
Cheval-chi! Then I'll turn it into 
Cheval-chi's favorite, Chinese-style sweet 
and sour sauce fish!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Leave filleting the fish to me! I 
practiced real hard! ...Though it still 
takes me a bit of time."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And after fishing, let's have a party at a 
shop nearby. When I told them it's my cute 
little sister's birthday, they were 
thrilled to help out♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
When did you...? Um, you really didn't 
need to go to such great lengths...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
We want to celebrate you. Your birthday is 
a much more special and wonderful day than 
you realize!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm definitely gonna make 
Cheva-chi smile! Just you wait and enjoy 
Big Sis's master plan, okay~?
